name: Dimitrios Katsaros
bio:
Dimitrios's journey into motorsport was sparked by a childhood spent tinkering with engines on his grandfather's farm in rural Greece. He was fascinated by the precision and engineering required to coax maximum performance from machines. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from the National Technical University of Athens, he began his career at a small, local racing team, where he quickly gained a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and unwavering commitment to quality. 

Driven by a desire to work at the highest level, Dimitrios joined Prema Racing three years ago. He sees his role as quality control as far more than just checking boxes; it's about fostering a culture of excellence throughout the team. He approaches every task with a visionary mindset, constantly seeking innovative ways to improve processes and push the boundaries of performance. His colleagues know him as a perfectionist who never settles for 'good enough', always striving for the best.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Dimitrios is a man of average height with a wiry build and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Insists on using a vintage slide rule for complex calculations, despite having access to modern software.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses even when they are perfectly in place.
